title: Azure Technical Support Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 The Technical Support Engineer (TSE) is the cornerstone of our services engagements. He is expected to be a trusted advisor and a technology guide to our customers, and help in deployment, design and planning of complex technology deployments that are well aligned to customer business needs. The TSE is a vital cog in our customer relationship, and must possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills, as well as leverage Quadra's internal teams to deliver high quality services to our customers. This role is ideal for candidates who can commit to intense learning and field activity, and enjoy travelling, and troubleshooting complex problems. Selected candidates must be willing to relocate to our offices in Bangalore/Chennai/Coimbatore. 
 
 Education and Experience 
 Bachelor or master degree on any computer/IT stream Knowledge on cloud technology, different patterns, deployment methods, compatibility of the applications 
 
 Experience in the following 
 Conceptual knowledge of Azure IaaS deployments and administration Experience on Azure IaaS core services which includes Network, Storage, Compute Familiarity with OS Internals concepts, built-in diagnostics, Active Directory and Security (Windows and or Linux) Understanding of Virtualization concepts and virtual system administration Familiarity with SAN/NAS, Hyper-V/VMWare, iSCSI Familiarity with networking concepts including TCP/IP, NAT, DNS Working knowledge of troubleshooting tools including Sysinternals, Fiddler, Netmon, NetStat, Tracert etc. Familiarity with one, or more, shell environments (BASH, sh, tcsh, ksh, etc.) Familiarity with core OS services such as: SSH, telnet, FTP, NFS, DNS, DHCP, Samba, LDAP Experience with Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, Azure Automation, Azure Log Analytics is a plus Working knowledge of Cloud Identity (Azure Active Directory, ADFS) is a plus 
 
 Success Factors 
 Strong technology fundamentals - networking, core infrastructure and cloud Up to date with current cloud technologies Should be able to work well as a team player Must be flexible adaptable to change Key values - honesty, integrity, passion for customers and technology 
 
 Interface/Communication 
 Well-developed interpersonal skills and excellent presentation skills. Must be accomplished in making presentations Uses CRM tools to update daily activities
